HEAVEN_TALK.intro.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.intro.occasion: THE FIRST VISIT EVER: GRAB at the god. Each line its own plate, in order. Then nothing else that visit.
value: DO NOT CRY, LITTLE GOAT. NOT ALL IS LOST.
I AM THE GOAT GOD. THE ONE ABOVE.
I CANNOT BRING BACK YOUR EWE. BUT I CAN TURN BACK TIME.
AND I WILL HELP YOU GROW STRONGER ON YOUR WAY.
SACRIFICE TO ME 15 SOULS OF THOSE WHO WANTED TO SACRIFICE YOU, AND I WILL GIVE YOU MORE POWER.
WHEN YOU ARE READY, JUMP OFF THE EDGE OF THE CLOUD. BUTT FIRST. BEH.

HEAVEN_TALK.life.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.life.occasion: Over the death card, the first death after a visit up here: his second chance (ONE MORE LIFE on every run from then on). Once.
value: FROM NOW ON I GIVE YOU A SECOND CHANCE. YOU FELL ONCE. GET BACK UP.

HEAVEN_TALK.gift.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.gift.occasion: The next talk for a goat who met him before the gift existed (an old store with no `gift`).
value: WAIT. I FORGOT SOMETHING. HOLD STILL. ...THERE. A LITTLE OF MY LIGHT, IN YOUR HORNS.
NOW EVERY MAN YOU PUT DOWN LEAVES A SMALL WHITE SOUL. WALK OUT OF THE ROOM AND THEY FOLLOW YOU. BRING THEM.
FIFTEEN. BRING ME FIFTEEN, AND I WILL REPAIR MY MIRROR FOR YOU.

HEAVEN_TALK.mend.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.mend.occasion: The next talk once twenty souls are brought and the mirror is still broken; after it he mends the glass himself (GRAB at it).
value: FIFTEEN. I COUNTED THEM. TWICE. ONE OF THEM WAS A DUCK, BUT I WILL ALLOW IT.
MY LIGHT IS IN YOUR HORNS NOW. GO TO MY MIRROR AND HOLD STILL BEFORE IT. POUR THE FIFTEEN INTO IT, AND IT WILL BE WHOLE.
WHOLE, IT TURNS WHAT YOU BRING ME INTO STRENGTH THAT OUTLIVES YOU. AND WHEN I HAVE ASKED MY LAST, IT SHOWS WHAT IT KEEPS AT THE BACK.

HEAVEN_TALK.animal.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.animal.occasion: The next talk once the mirror is whole and no animal has been brought out of the compound yet (once).
value: ONE MORE THING. THE CULT KEEPS ANIMALS DOWN THERE. FOR SUPPER. EVERY ONE HAS A STAND UP HERE, BY MY THRONE AND OVER MY BRIDGE.
THE TORTOISE'S STAND IS WHOLE: IT IS DOWN THERE ALREADY, WAITING FOR YOU. THE GOOSE'S AND THE HORSE'S ARE BROKEN. POUR SOULS INTO ONE, AND ITS ANIMAL WALKS YOUR RUNS. THE REST, LATER.
BRING ONE OUT ALIVE. IT WILL SIT UP HERE AND ASK SOMETHING OF YOU. HEAR IT OUT.

HEAVEN_TALK.horns.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.horns.occasion: Not at the god: said at the lip of the drop as he walks up to jump, the mirror whole and looked into (once).
value: WAIT, LITTLE GOAT. I FORGOT TO TELL YOU.
IF YOU GATHER THIRTY SOULS AND GIVE THEM TO ME, MY HORNS ARE YOURS. NOT THESE: A WIDE PAIR, AND A LONG ONE. THEY LIE HERE BY THE EDGE.
BRING THEM, STAND BEFORE ME AND HOLD STILL, AND POUR. NOW GO ON. JUMP.

HEAVEN_TALK.hornsNow.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.hornsNow.occasion: At the god, in place of the lip's ask, when the goat already carries the thirty for the horns (once).
value: WAIT, LITTLE GOAT. YOU ALREADY CARRY THIRTY.
GIVE THEM TO ME AND MY HORNS ARE YOURS. NOT THESE: A WIDE PAIR, AND A LONG ONE. THEY LIE HERE BY THE EDGE.
STAND BEFORE ME, HOLD STILL, AND POUR. NOW.

HEAVEN_TALK.hornsDone.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.hornsDone.occasion: Over the god as the fiftieth soul is poured into him (GRAB held at his cloud).
value: THIRTY. THE HORNS BY THE EDGE ARE YOURS NOW. PICK A PAIR BEFORE YOU JUMP. AND THE LOCKS ARE OFF THE OTHER STANDS: POUR SOULS INTO ONE, AND ITS ANIMAL IS DOWN THERE FOR YOU.

HEAVEN_TALK.hornsShut.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.hornsShut.occasion: GRAB on BIG or LONG at the edge before the fifty are given.
value: NOT YET, LITTLE HORNS. THIRTY SOULS, GIVEN TO ME, AND THEY ARE YOURS.
THOSE ARE MINE UNTIL YOU BRING ME MY THIRTY.

HEAVEN_TALK.skills.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.skills.occasion: The next talk once the horns are open (once).
value: NOW THE LAST THING I WILL ASK OF YOU. SIXTY SOULS, GIVEN TO ME, AND ONE CORRUPTED SOUL, THE VIOLET KIND THE CULT KEEPS IN ITS BIG MEN.
BRING THEM, AND WHAT YOU DO DOWN THERE WILL GROW. UPGRADED SKILLS.

HEAVEN_TALK.skillsDone.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.skillsDone.occasion: Over the god as the hundred and the corrupted soul are in.
value: SIXTY, AND THE VIOLET ONE. YOUR SKILLS ARE UPGRADED.

HEAVEN_TALK.skillsSoul.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.skillsSoul.occasion: Over the god when the hundred are poured in but no corrupted soul has been brought up yet.
value: SIXTY. NOW THE CORRUPTED ONE: TAKE A SOUL FROM ONE OF THEIR BIG MEN AND BRING IT UP.

HEAVEN_TALK.broken.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.broken.occasion: GRAB on the mirror before twenty souls are brought.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.bearer.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.bearer.occasion: The next talk after a death to BEARER.
value: A MAN WITH A STICK. YOU HAVE TWO HORNS AND FOUR LEGS. DO THE ARITHMETIC.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.brute.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.brute.occasion: The next talk after a death to BRUTE.
value: THE BUTCHER THROWS HIS HOOK WHERE YOU ARE GOING, LITTLE HORNS. TURN AFTER IT LEAVES HIS HAND.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.shield.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.shield.occasion: The next talk after a death to SHIELD.
value: A MAN BEHIND A DOOR. HE TURNS LIKE A DOOR, TOO. SLOWLY. GO ROUND HIM, LITTLE HORNS.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.butcher.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.butcher.occasion: The next talk after a death to BUTCHER.
value: THE OGRE. YOUR HORNS DO NOTHING TO HIM. FIRE DOES. BLADES DO.
YOUR HORNS DO NOTHING TO HIM. I SAY IT TWICE BECAUSE YOU FORGOT IT ONCE.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.seer.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.seer.occasion: The next talk after a death to SEER.
value: THE MAGE AND HIS PURPLE FIRE. WHEN THE FLOOR UNDER YOU GLOWS, THE FLOOR IS NOT YOUR FRIEND.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.hunter.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.hunter.occasion: The next talk after a death to HUNTER.
value: A RIFLE. HE TAKES A MOMENT TO AIM. A GOAT TAKES A MOMENT TO LEAVE. RACE HIM.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.rifle.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.rifle.occasion: The next talk after a death to RIFLE.
value: A RIFLE. HE TAKES A MOMENT TO AIM. A GOAT TAKES A MOMENT TO LEAVE. RACE HIM.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.dog.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.dog.occasion: The next talk after a death to DOG.
value: A HOUND. IT JUMPS AT YOU: PUT YOUR HORNS WHERE IT LANDS. I DO NOT CARE FOR DOGS EITHER.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.shaman.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.shaman.occasion: The next talk after a death to SHAMAN.
value: THE SHAMAN CALLS, AND YOUR LEGS ANSWER HIM. STEP OUT OF HIS SIGHT, AND THEY ARE YOURS AGAIN.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.thrower.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.thrower.occasion: The next talk after a death to THROWER.
value: THE THROWER. EVERYTHING IN HIS ROOM IS A STONE TO HIM. YOU TOO. ROLL WHEN THE ARM GOES BACK.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.toss.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.toss.occasion: The next talk after a death to TOSS.
value: HE THREW YOU AT A WALL. YOU KNOW WHAT WALLS DO TO MEN. THEY DO IT TO GOATS AS WELL.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.altar.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.altar.occasion: The next talk after a death to ALTAR.
value: THEIR ALTAR. I STOOD ON IT ONCE TOO. IT IS NOT FOR STANDING ON. IT IS FOR PUTTING THEM ON.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.abandon.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.abandon.occasion: The next talk after a death to ABANDON.
value: YOU GAVE UP. ...I DID NOT KNOW A GOAT COULD. DO NOT LEARN IT.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.wraith.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.wraith.occasion: The next talk after a death to WRAITH.
value: THE MIST. IT ONLY BECOMES A BODY BEHIND YOU. SO LOOK BEHIND YOU. CONSTANTLY. LIKE A GOAT.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.ratogre.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.ratogre.occasion: The next talk after a death to RATOGRE.
value: YOU ANGERED THE MOUSE. EVERYBODY KNOWS NOT TO ANGER THE MOUSE.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.fire.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.fire.occasion: The next talk after a death to FIRE.
value: YOU WALKED INTO FIRE. FIRE IS HOT. THAT IS THE WHOLE LESSON, AND YOU HAVE HAD IT.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.witchfire.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.witchfire.occasion: The next talk after a death to WITCHFIRE.
value: PURPLE FIRE. HOTTER THAN THE ORANGE KIND, AND FAR RUDER.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.spike.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.spike.occasion: The next talk after a death to SPIKE.
value: THE FLOOR BIT YOU. THE FLOOR IN THAT PLACE BITES. STEP OFF IT WHILE IT THINKS ABOUT IT.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.spire.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.spire.occasion: The next talk after a death to SPIRE.
value: THE STONE TEETH WERE THERE BEFORE YOU AND WILL BE THERE AFTER. WALK ROUND.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.bomb.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.bomb.occasion: The next talk after a death to BOMB.
value: THE ROUND BLACK THING WITH THE SPARK. YOU HELD ON TO IT. WHY DID YOU HOLD ON TO IT.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.powder.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.powder.occasion: The next talk after a death to POWDER.
value: BLACK POWDER ON THE FLOOR AND A FLAME NEARBY. YOU DID THE ARITHMETIC TOO LATE.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.chandelier.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.chandelier.occasion: The next talk after a death to CHANDELIER.
value: A CHANDELIER. YOU PULLED THE ROPE AND STOOD UNDER IT. I HAVE SEEN THAT JOKE BEFORE. IT WAS NOT FUNNY THEN EITHER.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.mill.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.mill.occasion: The next talk after a death to MILL.
value: THE WHEEL GOES ROUND. THAT IS ALL IT DOES, AND IT IS VERY GOOD AT IT.

HEAVEN_TALK.killer.fall.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.killer.fall.occasion: The next talk after a death to FALL.
value: YOU FELL. GOATS ARE SUPPOSED TO BE GOOD AT HEIGHTS. I AM DISAPPOINTED ON BEHALF OF ALL GOATS.

HEAVEN_TALK.again.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.again.occasion: Not said anywhere at the moment (kept for later).

HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.3.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.3.occasion: The next talk once his tally of deaths reaches 3 (once).
value: THIRD TIME. I HAVE STARTED A TALLY ON A CLOUD. IT IS A SMALL CLOUD.

HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.10.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.10.occasion: The next talk once his tally of deaths reaches 10 (once).
value: TEN. THE TALLY HAS A NAME NOW. GERALD.

HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.25.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.25.occasion: The next talk once his tally of deaths reaches 25 (once).
value: GERALD IS FULL. I HAVE STARTED ANOTHER CLOUD.

HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.50.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.50.occasion: The next talk once his tally of deaths reaches 50 (once).
value: FIFTY. THE MOST DEVOTED CORPSE I HAVE EVER HAD. I AM ALMOST TOUCHED.

HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.100.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.deaths.100.occasion: The next talk once his tally of deaths reaches 100 (once).
value: ONE HUNDRED. THE ANGELS ARE BETTING ON YOU. SO AM I. DO NOT TELL THEM.

HEAVEN_TALK.further.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.further.occasion: The next talk after a run that got further than ever; the line is picked by the floor reached.
value: {floor}. FURTHER THAN EVER. I MOVED MY SEAT TO THE EDGE TO WATCH.
YOU REACHED {floor}. THE CULT IS WORRIED. I CAN SMELL IT FROM HERE.

HEAVEN_TALK.saved.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.saved.occasion: The next talk after an animal was brought up for the first time ({animal} its name).

HEAVEN_TALK.praise.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.praise.occasion: On its own, over him soon after he comes up, when an animal was brought up or freed this run.
value: WELL DONE, LITTLE HORNS. {animal} THANKS YOU.

HEAVEN_TALK.mirror.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.mirror.occasion: The next talk after a rank was bought on the mirror (once).
value: YOU LOOKED INTO MY MIRROR, AND IT LOOKED BACK. IT LIKES YOU. IT DOES NOT LIKE MANY.

HEAVEN_TALK.combed.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.combed.occasion: The next talk after the shepherd combed him (once).
value: THE OLD MAN COMBED YOU. YOU SMELL OF CLOUDS NOW. IT IS AN IMPROVEMENT.

HEAVEN_TALK.song.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.song.occasion: The next talk after the bells' song was played through (once).
value: MARY HAD A LITTLE LAMB. ON MY BELLS. IN MY HEAVEN. ...FINE. THAT ONE IS ALLOWED.

HEAVEN_TALK.any.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.any.occasion: The next talk when nothing above is due: each line once, in order, then one at random.
value: THEY SACRIFICE GOATS TO THEIR GOD. I HAVE MET THEIR GOD. HE IS A SMALL MAN IN A LARGE HAT.
WHEN YOU FALL, FALL WITH DIGNITY. OR AT LEAST FALL ON A CULTIST.
A WALL IS A FRIEND WHO NEVER MOVES. INTRODUCE YOUR ENEMIES TO IT.
THE CLOUDS ARE NOT FOR EATING. I KNOW. I CHECKED. EXTENSIVELY.
HEADBUTT FIRST. ASK QUESTIONS NEVER. THAT IS THE WHOLE OF THE LAW.
BEH. THAT IS ALL. SOMETIMES A GOD ONLY WANTS TO SAY BEH.
THE ONES WITH THE STICKS SHOUT "STOP THE GOAT". NOBODY HAS EVER STOPPED A GOAT. IT IS NOT IN US.
I WAS ON THAT ALTAR TOO, ONCE. THE SAME KNIFE. I GOT BETTER. UP HERE. EVENTUALLY.
THE OLD MAN'S BELLS RANG UP HERE EVERY MORNING, ONCE. THE CULT TOOK THEM. BRING THEM BACK, AND I WILL PRETEND NOT TO BE MOVED.
GRASS HEALS. STANDING STILL IN IT HEALS. YOU NEVER STAND STILL. THAT IS YOUR PROBLEM.
THE ROLL IS FOR LEAVING. YOU ARE VERY GOOD AT ARRIVING. WORK ON THE LEAVING.

HEAVEN_TALK.bye.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.bye.occasion: GRAB at the god again on the same visit, once he has had his talk.
value: GO. THE EDGE IS THAT WAY. BEH.
STILL HERE? THE CULT WILL NOT BUTT ITSELF.

HEAVEN_TALK.butted.speaker: THE GOD
value: THAT TICKLED. DO IT AGAIN AND I SEND YOU TO THE TRIP.

HEAVEN_TALK.goOn.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.goOn.occasion: A goat who has never jumped yet, dawdling up here for a while (before the arrows appear at the lip).
value: WELL? JUMP. GO ON, DOWN YOU GO.

HEAVEN_TALK.notYet.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.notYet.occasion: Walking to the drop before ever looking into the mirror: he is put back a step and told.
value: NOT YET, LITTLE GOAT. THE MIRROR FIRST.
THE MIRROR, UP THERE. LOOK INTO IT, THEN JUMP.

HEAVEN_TALK.munch.speaker: THE GOD
HEAVEN_TALK.munch.occasion: Over the goat's mouth while he grazes the gold grass.

SHEPHERD_TALK.hello.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.hello.occasion: Walking up to the shepherd the first time this visit (the second line for a goat he has combed before).
value: WHO IS THAT? A LITTLE KID. COME HERE, LET ME COMB YOU.
AH, THE LITTLE KID AGAIN. COME, COME.

SHEPHERD_TALK.comb.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.comb.occasion: During the comb, every few strokes.
value: SUCH KNOTS. WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN, LITTLE GOAT?
YOU SMELL OF SMOKE AND MEN.
YOUR HORNS HAVE GROWN. NOT SO LITTLE NOW.
I HAD A FLOCK ONCE. THEY CAME AT NIGHT, WITH CLOTH AND ROPE. I HEARD IT ALL.
MY WIFE DID THE COMBING. I ONLY COUNTED THEM.
SOFT AS A CLOUD NOW. SOFTER.

SHEPHERD_TALK.butted.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
value: OH! STILL SOME SPIRIT IN YOU.

SHEPHERD_TALK.bells.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.bells.occasion: A bell butted: he hears it and answers from where he stands.
value: WHO IS AT THE BELLS? THE LITTLE KID?
NOT SO HARD. THEY ARE OLDER THAN I AM.
THAT ONE IS FLAT. IT ALWAYS WAS.
AH, I KNOW THAT ONE. HOW DOES IT GO ON?
MY WIFE RANG THEM LIKE THAT. EVERY MORNING.
GOATS DO NOT RING BELLS. OR DO THEY NOW?

SHEPHERD_TALK.quest.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.quest.value: MY BELLS, LITTLE KID. THE CULT TOOK THEM THE NIGHT THEY TOOK THE FLOCK. ALL BUT THE SMALLEST. | THEIR BIG MEN WEAR THEM NOW, THE LAST MAN ON EVERY FLOOR. BEAT HIM, TAKE HIS BELL, HANG IT HERE. | ALL OF THEM HOME, AND I WILL PLAY YOU WHAT MY WIFE PLAYED.

SHEPHERD_TALK.asleep.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.asleep.occasion: An empty hook butted (a bell not won from its boss yet).
value: NOTHING HANGS THERE YET. THE LAST BIG MAN OF A FLOOR HAS IT.
AN EMPTY HOOK. BEAT THE LAST MAN OF A FLOOR AND TAKE HIS BELL.

SHEPHERD_TALK.woke.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.woke.occasion: Coming up with a bell hung since the last visit.
value: I HEARD THAT. ANOTHER ONE IS HOME.
ANOTHER BELL. YOU TOOK IT OFF ONE OF THEM, DID YOU NOT?

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.come.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.come.value: ALL OF THEM HOME. WAIT THERE. LET AN OLD MAN PLAY.

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.listen.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.listen.value: LISTEN, LITTLE KID. THIS WAS HERS.

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.you.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.you.value: NOW YOU. WHEN THE LIGHT FALLS ON A BELL, RING IT.

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.good.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.good.value: HA! JUST SO. HEAR HOW THEY GO ON WITHOUT US.

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.fair.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.fair.value: NOT BAD FOR HORNS. LISTEN, THEY GO ON BY THEMSELVES.

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.poor.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.poor.value: NEVER MIND. THEY KNOW IT NOW. LISTEN.

SHEPHERD_TALK.song.end.speaker: THE SHEPHERD
SHEPHERD_TALK.song.end.value: THERE. BUTT ME AND WE PLAY IT AGAIN.

DEATH_TIPS.any.speaker: A DEATH
DEATH_TIPS.any.occasion: At the foot of a floor tried again after a death, a few seconds: one of these when the killer has no tips of his own.
value: YOUR HORNS ONLY KNOCK A MAN DOWN. WHAT KILLS HIM IS THE WALL YOU AIM HIM AT.
A POISONED OR STUNNED MAN DIES ON A WALL FROM A SOFTER HIT.
RIGHT M. CLICK GRABS A THING. LET GO AND YOU THROW IT.
POISON SLOWS THE CULT AND BLINDS THE RIFLEMEN.
FIRE MAKES SOME OF THEM PANIC AND RUN. OTHERS COME AT YOU FASTER.
THE YELLOW ONES ARE CHAMPIONS: MORE HEARTS, AND HARDER TO PUSH.

BEAST_HELLO.chicken.speaker: CHICKEN
BEAST_HELLO.chicken.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).
value: I'LL FOLLOW YOU. BUTT ME AT A MAN AND I FLY AT HIM.
GET ME UP THE STAIRS ALIVE AND I'LL LEND YOU A LITTLE HEART. I'VE GOT PLENTY.

BEAST_HELLO.tortoise.speaker: TORTOISE
BEAST_HELLO.tortoise.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).
value: I AM SLOW. CARRY ME IN YOUR TEETH, OR THROW ME AT THEM. MY SHELL TAKES ONE BLOW FOR YOU.
BRING ME OUT, AND ON EVERY FLOOR AFTER YOU WILL WEAR A SHELL OF YOUR OWN.

BEAST_HELLO.goose.speaker: GOOSE
BEAST_HELLO.goose.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).
value: I RUN AHEAD AND TELL THEM ALL WHERE YOU ARE. WE'RE HERE TO KICK THEIR ASS!!!
GET ME UP THE STAIRS AND I'LL TEACH YOU TO SHOUT. LOUDER, AND MORE OFTEN.

BEAST_HELLO.crow.speaker: CROW
BEAST_HELLO.crow.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).
value: I DO NOT FOLLOW YOU. I FOLLOW THE ROAD OF BODIES.
KEEP ME FED ALL THE WAY TO THE STAIRS, AND I'LL BRING YOU SOMETHING SHINY.

BEAST_HELLO.rabbit.speaker: RABBIT
BEAST_HELLO.rabbit.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).
value: LET ME TIE YOUR LEGS. NO RUNNING: YOUR ROLL IS YOUR HOP, WHERE YOU POINT. HORNS, VOICE AND TEETH STILL WORK.
HOP UP THE STAIRS WITH ME LIKE THAT, AND EVERY ROLL AFTER WILL COME BACK TO YOU QUICKER. SHALL I TIE THEM?

BEAST_HELLO.husky.speaker: HUSKY
BEAST_HELLO.husky.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).
value: I SING WAF-WOOO, YOU ANSWER WITH YOUR BAAH, ON THE BEAT. FIRST JUST US, THEN RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF A FIGHT.
SING WITH ME AND COME UP THE STAIRS, AND YOUR THROAT WILL BE A SINGER'S: IT NEVER RESTS FOR LONG. SING?

BEAST_HELLO.fish.speaker: FISH
BEAST_HELLO.fish.occasion: The animal is let out of its coop: page 1 its sound, then its terms, then its reward hint (a box, a verb turns the page).

BEAST_ANSWER.yes.speaker: THE GOAT / THE ANIMAL
BEAST_ANSWER.yes.occasion: After an animal has said its terms: yes (BAAAH) or no (bah); refused, it goes its way and says one of `refused`.

BEAST_ANSWER.yesSay.speaker: THE GOAT / THE ANIMAL
BEAST_ANSWER.yesSay.occasion: After an animal has said its terms: yes (BAAAH) or no (bah); refused, it goes its way and says one of `refused`.

BEAST_ANSWER.no.speaker: THE GOAT / THE ANIMAL
BEAST_ANSWER.no.occasion: After an animal has said its terms: yes (BAAAH) or no (bah); refused, it goes its way and says one of `refused`.

BEAST_ANSWER.noSay.speaker: THE GOAT / THE ANIMAL
BEAST_ANSWER.noSay.occasion: After an animal has said its terms: yes (BAAAH) or no (bah); refused, it goes its way and says one of `refused`.

BEAST_ANSWER.refused.speaker: THE GOAT / THE ANIMAL
BEAST_ANSWER.refused.occasion: After an animal has said its terms: yes (BAAAH) or no (bah); refused, it goes its way and says one of `refused`.

BEAST_CHAT.chicken.kill.speaker: CHICKEN
BEAST_CHAT.chicken.kill.occasion: On the road, over the animal: a man is put down near it.

BEAST_CHAT.chicken.big.speaker: CHICKEN
BEAST_CHAT.chicken.big.occasion: On the road, over the animal: a boss or an ogre goes down.
value: THE BIG ONE! I NEARLY LAID AN EGG.

BEAST_CHAT.chicken.clear.speaker: CHICKEN
BEAST_CHAT.chicken.clear.occasion: On the road, over the animal: the room's last man falls.
value: IS IT SAFE? IT IS SAFE.
ALL GONE. NOW, SIT UP STRAIGHT.

BEAST_CHAT.chicken.fight.speaker: CHICKEN
BEAST_CHAT.chicken.fight.occasion: On the road, over the animal: the cult has seen him.

TUNING.prop.horse.lines.pay.speaker: HORSE
TUNING.prop.horse.lines.pay.value: A BET IS A BET. RUN ON MY LEGS

TUNING.prop.horse.talk.race.speaker: HORSE
TUNING.prop.horse.talk.race.occasion: TUNING.prop.horse.talk.race (the animal box, a page a line)
value: NEIGH! RACE YOU TO THE LOCKED DOOR WITH THE SOUL BEHIND IT.
{tries}: THAT DOOR, THEN THE STAIRS. BEAT ME ONCE AND YOU CAN KEEP MY LEGS. YOU WON'T.

TUNING.prop.horse.talk.raceOne.speaker: HORSE
TUNING.prop.horse.talk.raceOne.occasion: TUNING.prop.horse.talk.raceOne (the animal box, a page a line)
value: NEIGH! RACE YOU TO THE STAIRS.
ONE TRY. BEAT ME AND YOU CAN KEEP MY LEGS. YOU WON'T.

TUNING.prop.horse.talk.beaten.speaker: HORSE
TUNING.prop.horse.talk.beaten.occasion: TUNING.prop.horse.talk.beaten (the animal box, a page a line)
value: A BET IS A BET. MY LEGS ARE YOURS NOW, ALL THE WAY OUT.

TUNING.prop.horse.talk.cheated.speaker: HORSE
TUNING.prop.horse.talk.cheated.occasion: TUNING.prop.horse.talk.cheated (the animal box, a page a line)
value: THAT WAS A FOUL! CHEAT! CHEAT!
BUT A WIN IS A WIN, I SUPPOSE. TAKE MY LEGS, YOU DIRTY GOAT.

TUNING.prop.pig.spite.say.speaker: PIG
value: NO? FINE. ALL OF IT IS MINE, THEN.

TUNING.prop.pig.talk.hello.speaker: PIG
TUNING.prop.pig.talk.hello.occasion: TUNING.prop.pig.talk.hello (the animal box, a page a line)
value: I'M NOT RACING ANYBODY. I'M JUST HUNGRY.
SPARE ME {n} OF YOUR GRASSES. A FED PIG NEVER FORGETS WHERE THE GOOD GRASS GROWS.

TUNING.prop.pig.talk.full.speaker: PIG
TUNING.prop.pig.talk.full.occasion: TUNING.prop.pig.talk.full (the animal box, a page a line)
value: THAT'S ME FULL. THANK YOU, GOAT.
YOU GET TO THE STAIRS, AND I'LL SNIFF YOU OUT A LITTLE EXTRA ON EVERY FLOOR AHEAD.

TUNING.prop.husky.practice.say.speaker: HUSKY
TUNING.prop.husky.practice.say.value: JUST US FIRST: BAAH AS YOUR NOTE CROSSES THE LINE

TUNING.prop.husky.practice.good.speaker: HUSKY
TUNING.prop.husky.practice.good.value: YES! NOW FOR REAL. FOLLOW ME!

TUNING.misc.endBoss.mage.wardenLine.speaker: SCENE
TUNING.misc.endBoss.mage.wardenLine.value: MINE NOW, GOAT. COME AND TAKE HER.

TUNING.misc.endBoss.hunter.scene.line.speaker: SCENE
TUNING.misc.endBoss.hunter.scene.line.value: RUN, GOAT. THEY LIKE A RUNNER.

TUNING.misc.endBoss.glimpse.line.speaker: SCENE
TUNING.misc.endBoss.glimpse.line.value: STILL COMING, GOAT? SHE IS KEPT FOR THE TABLE.

TUNING.misc.endBoss.supper.scene.lines.speaker: SCENE
value: YOUR BELOVED AND I HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR YOU, LITTLE GOAT.
COME IN. SIT. EAT WITH US.

TUNING.misc.endBoss.supper.drop.lines.speaker: SCENE
value: GOOD, LITTLE ONE. NOW, LET'S DANCE.

TUNING.misc.endBoss.supper.knock.lines.speaker: SCENE
value: (I AM THE DANGER. I AM THE ONE WHO KNOCKS.)

TUNING.misc.warden.turn.lines.speaker: SCENE
value: SO YOU ARE A STUBBORN ONE, IT TURNS OUT...
NO MATTER. WE WILL FIX THAT.

TUNING.misc.warden.gloat.line.speaker: SCENE
TUNING.misc.warden.gloat.line.value: YOU WERE NOT AS TOUGH AS I THOUGHT.

TUNING.misc.thanks.lines.speaker: SCENE
value: Thank you for playing, little goat. Please spread the word near and far,
so that no other goat is ever led to the altar.

TUNING.misc.shroom.phase.text.value: OH, I WAS ACTUALLY OVER HERE
